main.description: Public wire entry point for the shinka Pregel super-step. Wire-shape parity with vendor shinka_tick_actor SQL UDF. If adherentDid is absent, ticks all due adherents per ADR-2605215200 §1.

adherentDid.description: Optional DID of a specific adherent to tick. If absent, all due adherents are ticked.

cycle.description: Current heartbeat cycle counter for this tick.

observed.description: Number of adherents observed during this tick.

validated.description: Number of evolution claims validated during this tick.

emitted.description: Number of evolution events emitted to MST during this tick.

errors.description: List of error messages encountered during this tick.
